name: secure-file-transfer
description: UCAS Software and System Security Experiment 1B

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @sft/server" "npm run dev --workspace @sft/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev --workspace @sft/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev --workspace @sft/client
scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @sft/server && npm run build --workspace @sft/client
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test --workspace @sft/protocol && npm run test --workspace @sft/server && npm run test --workspace @sft/client
